title: Restocking and Activated Device Fee Tariff, Northbeam Returns and Restocking
content:
The percentage, the floor, the ceiling and the flat device charge that each Northbeam Returns and Restocking schedule publishes, together with the two waiver flags that stand against the same schedules.

| Return schedule | Restocking fee percentage | Smallest fee charged | Largest fee on one line | Flat activated device fee |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | 10 per cent | 9.95 USD | 199.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | 10 per cent | 9.95 USD | 149.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | 15 per cent | 45.00 USD | 450.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | 0 per cent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 45.00 USD |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | 0 per cent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | 12 per cent | 25.00 USD | 900.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

**Footnote 1 — what each column is.** The percentage column is the restocking fee as a percentage of the line price. The smallest fee charged is the smallest restocking fee charged where the fee applies. The largest fee on one line is the largest restocking fee charged on one line. The flat activated device fee is the flat fee on returning a device already activated on a network.

**Footnote 2 — the two waiver flags.** Each schedule also publishes whether the restocking fee is waived when the item is graded defective, and whether a Circle member's fee is waived on that schedule.

| Return schedule | Fee waived when graded defective | Circle member's fee waived on this schedule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | yes | no |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | yes | yes |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | yes | no |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | yes | no |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | yes | no |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | yes | no |

**Footnote 3 — the tariff on Activated Wireless Device Return.** That schedule is the only one in this tariff publishing a flat device charge, and it publishes a zero percentage with a zero floor and a zero ceiling. Two schedules, Activated Wireless Device Return and Open Box and Clearance Final Sale, therefore carry no percentage figure at all.

**Footnote 4 — the floor and the ceiling are figures of one schedule.** The smallest fee and the largest fee are published against the same schedule as the percentage, and a schedule's floor is never read against another schedule's percentage.
